2. The criminal law has been set into3 motion based on the first information statement of Rathna.

The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused married CW-1 on 05-04-2021 and after the marriage accused No.1 to 4 with common intention have subjected CW-1 to mental and physical cruelty by assaulting her, asking her amount, sending her out of the house and when CW-1 complained  3  C.C.No.33914/2023 about the behaviour of accused No.1, the accused No.2 and 3 told that she has not brought sufficient dowry from her parents house and harassed her to get money from her father or to join for job and to give salary to them or else to leave the matrimonial home.
The accused have abused her in filthy language and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.275/2023 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.

sentences.text: The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as  6  C.C.No.33914/2023 hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.

In view of the material witness, turning hostile,
and in the absence of evidence of material witness, the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

12. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 7  C.C.No.33914/2023  ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 to 4 are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 323 of IPC. & Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 to 4 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
